description: A React component for managing data backups and imports within a web application, including download, upload, and version support logic.

methods.name: downloadDataArchive
methods.description: Handles exporting backup data, either encrypted or decrypted, and initiates download or sharing.

methods.name: readFile
methods.description: Reads a user-selected file, parsing JSON or handling zip files.

methods.name: performImport
methods.description: Performs import of data and shows success or error dialogs.

methods.name: importFileSelected
methods.description: Processes the selected import file, including version validation.

methods.name: handleImportFile
methods.description: Triggers file input dialog for importing backups, handling key events for accessibility.
